name: Passe
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.source_named: Extinct; only wordlists (von Martius 1867; Ramirez 2001) and comparative reclassification (Ramirez 2020); no phonological description

sources.citation: Ramirez, Henri & Maria Cristina Victorino de França. 2019. Línguas Arawak da Bolívia. LIAMES 19: e019012. doi:10.20396/liames.v19i0.8655045
sources.note: Nothing about Passé; the paper covers the Bolivia subgroup and only names the JC (Japurá-Colômbia) subgroup in its family tree (a full-text search for stress/accent Passé/Yumana returned no hits).

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.1, languoid pass1250 (0 descriptive references; Glottolog's most extensive descriptions: Ramirez 2001 wordlist, Martius 1867 wordlist) and Wikipedia 'Pasé language'
sources.note: Nothing; both record that Passé is attested only in a single 19th-century wordlist (Martius 1867 II: 254-256).

sources.citation: von Martius, Carl Friedrich Philipp. 1867. Beiträge zur Ethnographie und Sprachenkunde Amerika's zumal Brasiliens. II. Wörtersammlung brasilianischer Sprachen. Leipzig: Friedrich Fleischer. Passé wordlist pp. 254-256.
sources.note: Nothing. A ~230-item Latin-glossed wordlist plus numerals, footnoted 'Von Spix in der Fazenda Matmá, nicht weit von der Mündung des Içá in den Solimões, aufgenommen' (p. 254); a few forms carry diacritics (scanned ä/ü/ö) but there is no remark on accent. The only accent convention in the volume (pp. 29-30, Tupi dictionary intro) says the mark (') 'dient überhaupt, den Vocal zu schärfen oder die Sylbe zu betonen' — a note on Tupi orthography, not on Passé.

sources.citation: Spix, Johann Baptist von & Carl Friedrich Philipp von Martius. 1831. Reise in Brasilien.. Dritter Theil. München. Passés at the Içá/Maripi, pp. ~1186-1200.
sources.note: Nothing; ethnographic account (Principal Aisano presents thirty-odd Passés; naming customs, tattoo, cosmogony). No remark on the language's sounds or accent.

sources.citation: Ramirez, Henri. 2020 [e-book 2021]. Enciclopédia das línguas Arawak, acrescida de seis novas línguas e dois bancos de dados. Vol. 2 'O subgrupo Japurá-Colômbia (JC)', §4.10 Yumana e Passé (Y-P) pp. 160-162 and §4.12 Fonologia de JC pp. 164ff; also pp. 359-360, 429-539 (Passé data, per Glottolog). Curitiba: Editora CRV. ISBN 9786555788921 (vol. 2), 9786555788822 (vol. I e-book).
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: The only work with a phoneme inventory of (Yumana-)Passé reconstructed from the wordlists; the JC-wide phonology section might comment on accent in the subgroup and on how the 19th-century diacritics are read. TOC shows no 'acento' subsection for Y-P, so a Passé-specific stress statement is unlikely but this is the one place it could be.
